title: sql_descriptions
description: M2 — the natural-language question and prose for each verified SQL, keyed by vq_id. An OVERLAY: the layer exists without it and m1_merge applies it.

name.description: The BUSINESS alias — what people call this thing, in their own words ('Success Plan Sign-Off Rate'). Not a technical handle. It is the highest weight a search ranks.

question.description: Every business question this statement answers, in one string. Several are written one after another — 'How many X? What share of Y?' — because this becomes `display_name`, the highest human-readable weight a search ranks.
